author: Ogrey
body:
Hello guys, bringing you my latest map called Edron, for Nexus.
It's a pretty simple map with two spawns available for each team, should be fun to play on, hopefully!

Map Name: Edron
Map Creator: Evocal
Gamemode: Nexus
Teams:
- Redmond (Red) (30 players max) (2 teamspawns)
- Blutarch (Blue) (30 players max) (2 teamspawns)
Map Download & YML: https://www.mediafire.com/?ff6rq14jh4klk95

replies.author: MLGtino
replies.body:
I agree partially with vsplesk. If you fall into that gap, you're boned. You can't get out, and you can't expect other players to come get you.

Add more bridges and a tunnel system or something to get back up. Because other than that it would still need something to prevent the gameplay from being 1-Dimensional from just rushing in a straight line (which maps like sandstorm and arkashia suffer from).
